## X-Sense Home Security v1.4.20.3

### 🛡️ Detector Status
- Keeps the End-of-Life entity available for supported smoke, CO, and combination detectors.
- Shows the End-of-Life state as clear instead of unknown when X-Sense omits the field, matching the X-Sense app's status handling.

Please test the End-of-Life entity on your detector and report any model that still shows an unexpected state.
